# KS-1238 N83-2 PIN THAT POST /api/documents (DOCUMENT CREATE) ON A REFUSED EXCHANGE SENDS NO CALLER BEARER TO ORIGINATE — Wednesday's task for Ornith, TEST_ONLY, **ONE existing test file, four hunks, one key, one validation branch, one recorder line and one cell added, no product file** (written 2026-09-19, round 17; AUTH surface, test-only)

File: `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1238-hand-forwarded-routes-send-no-caller-bearer.test.ts`
Tip: `4273adfac57ab1a65b4a9983c566cc115faefc01`

Written from develop `4273adfac57ab1a65b4a9983c566cc115faefc01` (read with `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/develop` and `git rev-parse origin/develop` in the Secuura checkout, read-only; #1084-#1091 are merged there). The test file at that tip is 132 lines (it carries #1090's widened recorder); its full content is in `files[...]` of your input. The product the cell pins is `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/verification.ts`, the document-create handler (`router.post('/api/documents', authenticateToken(true), ...)`), its hand-built forward to originate `POST /api/documents` (`:1283-1320`), whose Authorization is copied at `:1297`. This service runs **VITEST**.

## THE MODE — read this twice

**TEST_ONLY.** Your diff touches EXACTLY ONE file: the test file above, MODIFIED IN PLACE (`--- a/<path>` / `+++ b/<path>`, the path exactly as written above). You never touch `verification.ts`, `index.ts`, `auth.ts` or any other product file: the behaviour is already right at the tip, and this cell PINS it.

## What the cell pins (one paragraph)

The document-create handler builds originate's headers by hand and copies `req.headers['authorization']` (`:1297`), the header the auth middleware left in place: on the connector branch with a REFUSED exchange, no Bearer (KS-1215). It is the fourth connector-branch hand-forwarded route KS-1238 (v) names. No cell sends a connector to it: the #1084-#1091 gate (report `2026-09-19-batch1084-1091-tier1-r1`, row **RAW1297**, the prior report's **N83-2** re-measured with all eight merged, Minor) made `:1297` read index.ts's pre-auth `rawAuthorization` first and the whole suite stayed GREEN (0 of 646). This change adds, all in the one file: a third key `CREATE_KEY` that the double validates `valid: true` with `scopes: ['documents:write']` and whose connector-token exchange is refused 401 (the double's existing rule: every key but `OK_KEY` is refused); a recorder line that also records originate's `POST /api/documents` (the existing recorder matches `/api/documents/` with a trailing slash, so the create call is not recorded today); and ONE cell: `CREATE_KEY` + a REVOKED session JWT creates a document, gets 200, and originate's create call receives no Bearer. Every existing cell is unchanged.

## The exact change — FOUR hunks in the test file

Copy every line byte for byte. Every `+` line is ASCII only. There is no blank line anywhere in the fence. Keep the headers exactly as shown. **Your diff MUST begin with the two file-header lines, above the first `@@` line: `--- a/Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1238-hand-forwarded-routes-send-no-caller-bearer.test.ts` then `+++ b/Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1238-hand-forwarded-routes-send-no-caller-bearer.test.ts`.**

1. The key, directly above `const SIG = '/api/signatories';` (`:26`, the ONE trailing context line; it occurs once).
2. The validation branch, inside the double's `/api/keys/validate` block, directly above its `      return json(200, key === OK_KEY || key === REFUSED_KEY` (`:60`, the ONE trailing context line; it occurs once). It sits AFTER `const key = ...` (`:59`, not written).
3. The recorder line for the create call, directly above the existing recorder line (`:69`, the ONE trailing context line; it occurs once). The existing recorder line is NOT changed.
4. The new cell, directly above the existing cell `  it('control: documents/:id/verify with a LIVE user JWT alone ...` (`:129`, the ONE trailing context line; it occurs once). There is NO leading context: the line above (`:128`, `  });`) stays and is not written.

```
@@ -26,1 +26,2 @@
+const CREATE_KEY = 'sk_ks1238_create_401_00001';
 const SIG = '/api/signatories';
@@ -60,1 +61,2 @@
+      if (key === CREATE_KEY) return json(200, { data: { valid: true, connectorId: 'ks1238-create', scopes: ['documents:write'], organizationId: 'org-ks1238', tenantId: TENANT, rateLimit: 1000, rateLimitWindow: 60 } });
       return json(200, key === OK_KEY || key === REFUSED_KEY
@@ -69,1 +71,2 @@

     if (url.startsWith(SIG) || url.startsWith(TPV) || url.startsWith(DOCS) || url.startsWith('/api/anchors/')) hits.push(bearerOf(req.headers.authorization as string | undefined));
@@ -129,1 +132,7 @@

+    const createMark = hits.length;
+    const created = await fetch(gatewayUrl + '/api/documents', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-api-key': CREATE_KEY, authorization: userJwt('ks1238-revoked') }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: 'ks1238', contentHash: 'a'.repeat(64) }) });
+    await created.text();
+    expect([created.status, hits.slice(createMark)]).toEqual([200, ['none']]);

```

`gatewayUrl`, `userJwt`, `bearerOf`, `json`, `TENANT` and the recorder `hits` (one `bearerOf(...)` string per recorded upstream call) are the file's own. The double's default reply (`{ success: true, data: [] }`, 200) is what originate answers the create with, and the handler pipes it back, so the gateway answers 200.

## Cells

- `create` = `RED documents (create): a valid key + a REVOKED session JWT, exchange refused, reaches originate with no Bearer`

## Tampers

### RAW1297 — the document-create forward reads the pre-auth rawAuthorization first
File: `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/verification.ts`
Line: 1297
From:
```
      if (req.headers['authorization']) forwardHeaders['authorization'] = req.headers['authorization'] as string;
```
To:
```
      if ((req as any).rawAuthorization || req.headers['authorization']) forwardHeaders['authorization'] = ((req as any).rawAuthorization || req.headers['authorization']) as string;
```
Reds: `create`

## Controls

- `RED documents/:id/verify: a valid key + a REVOKED session JWT, exchange refused, reaches originate with no Bearer`
- `RED documents/:id/verify: a valid key + a LIVE user JWT, exchange OK, reaches originate with the connector JWT, not the user Bearer`
- `control: documents/:id/verify with a LIVE user JWT alone reaches originate with the user own Bearer`
- `control: a valid key alone, exchange OK, reaches originate on both routes with the connector JWT`

## THE CELLS — state it to yourself before you write a line

At the untouched tip the new cell passes: `CREATE_KEY` validates (`documents:write`), the exchange is refused, so the connector branch drops the caller's Authorization and forwards none; the handler reaches `:1297` with no `authorization` header and sends none to originate's `POST /api/documents`, which the new recorder line records as `none`; the double answers 200 and the gateway pipes it: `[200, ['none']]`. Under RAW1297 the forward carries `rawAuthorization`, the caller's REVOKED JWT: the recorded hit is `user:ks1238-revoked`, a failure by assertion. No other cell POSTs `/api/documents` (the /verify cells POST `/api/documents/doc-ks1238/verify`, which the new recorder line does not match, and the old recorder records only `/api/documents/...`), so every other cell stays green.

## Premises (measured)

- **Premise: the tamper line.** `grep -nFx` of the `From` text over `verification.ts` at the tip: exactly one hit, `:1297`, inside the document-create handler.
- **Premise: the create call is reached in-process** (the gate's probe, and here: the cell is green at the tip and red under RAW1297 with the revoked JWT recorded).
- **Premise: the recorder line adds no hit to any existing cell.** It matches only `POST` with url exactly `/api/documents`; no existing cell sends that (the file had 1 `method: 'POST'` at the tip, the /verify helper).
- **No `+` line re-adds a tip line.** `CREATE_KEY`, `createMark`, `created`, `ks1238-create`, `req.method` occur 0 times in the file at the tip (the gate's proposed cell used `const mark = hits.length;`, a near-duplicate of `:98`; renamed `createMark` / `created`). The only `+` line that also occurs at the tip is the closing `  });` (unavoidable for a new cell). Each trailing context line (`:26`, `:60`, `:69`, `:129`) is non-blank and occurs once.
- **No ruling is decided here.** This pins only that the create forward carries the post-auth header (none on a refused exchange), the property the file's other KS-1238 cells pin for their routes.

## Measured results

Measured 2026-09-19 by the round-17 brief subagent at develop `4273adfac` itself: a `git clone --shared` scratch clone, the harness's own `prepare_clone.sh` farm, the service's own vitest (JSON report, whole api-gateway suite), each tamper planted after an exact-and-unique `From` match and restored by bytes (sha256 asserted = tip blob after every run).
- Whole api-gateway suite: untouched tip **646/646**; tip + this diff **647/647**, 0 red.
- WITHOUT the diff: RAW1297 **0 of 646** (the gate's N83-2 gap reproduced; plant sha256 `d5188b1d3fb6`).
- WITH the diff: RAW1297 **exactly 1 red of 647**, `create` (`expected [ 200, [ 'user:ks1238-revoked' ] ] to deeply equal [ 200, [ 'none' ] ]`), a vitest AssertionError; only this file fails.
- **Product bytes unchanged (TEST-ONLY):** 9 `+`, 0 `-`, one file header pair (the test file); `verification.ts` sha256 `43d29242eda1` and `platform.ts` `7d04a92ca724` = the tip blobs after every run, clone clean.
- CHECKER_RESULT_PLACEHOLDER

## Collision with HELD KS-1238-N90-1 (same file)

The held N90-1 (canonical patch `runs/2026-09-19_ks1238-ornith35b-night7/out.md.checker/patch.diff`, hunks at `:70` and `:132`) touches this file. This diff's hunks sit at `:26`, `:60`, `:69` and `:129` and share no context line with it (its `:70` insert lands directly below this diff's `:69` insert's trailing line either way; its `:132` cell is below `:129`-`:131`). Both orders measured with strict `git apply` (no `--recount`, no fuzz): N83-2 then N90-1 and N90-1 then N83-2 both apply (rc 0) and give the SAME blob **`156f708272707fe2c13f9e5cfac9c2035bb42f9d`** (tip blob `0a37c1d56be8`; N83-2 alone `7157d51b1bd7`, N90-1 alone `1cb8a72ddaa1`). On the combined tree of all five round-16/17 KS-1238 diffs (this, N90-1, N83-6, KS-1282-N91-2, N91-1) the whole suite is **651/651**; RAW1297 reds exactly `create` (1 of 651) and N90-1's RAW598 reds exactly its own `docfound` (1 of 651).

## Output

Exactly ONE ```diff block, nothing outside it: `--- a/Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1238-hand-forwarded-routes-send-no-caller-bearer.test.ts` / `+++ b/Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1238-hand-forwarded-routes-send-no-caller-bearer.test.ts`, then the four hunks above exactly as shown, in order.

Refs KS-1238** ((v) `verification.ts:1297`, RAW1297 / prior N83-2, Minor, from the batch #1084-#1091 gate `2026-09-19-batch1084-1091-tier1-r1`, NOT-PINNED RAW1297). NEVER Closes. KS-1238 stays in Backlog (NOT-COMPLETE) until (iii) N91-1, (iv) N83-6 and (v) RAW598 (N90-1) are also merged.
